facts.paraphrase: The derivative authors identify Zhou as their original data source, identify additional physiological measures from the companion study, and declare that all obtained data had been made publicly available by the original authors under Stanford IRB23602.

The derivative authors associate the original publicly available data with the Stanford iPOP site and declare that all data files used, code and results were released in the explicitly named gmiaslab/TemporalMultiomicsDiabetes repository and deposited at Zenodo DOI10.5281/zenodo.6751960 as Online Data Files.
The commit-pinned README associates the data directory with original/mapped Zhou data and metadata, with additional diabetes measures from the companion study.

The original authors identify unrestricted public HMP2 and Stanford release routes, specify CC0 data and MIT software, and identify a dbGaP exome route. The MIT code license is distinct from the data declaration.
Public HMP T2D materials include clinical laboratory data through2016; data from participants not consenting to public release are directed to dbGaP phs001719.v1.p1.

Publication clinical/survey availability through June2018 differs from multiomics availability through December2016 and from the main iHMP analysis cohort. Those later analytical measurements cannot automatically be assigned to the public2016 release.
